metadata.description: Brett Callaghan's Claude Code plugins: specs (spec-first authoring, grooming and retrospectives) and release (cutting releases with the release CLI)

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Spec-first development — feature requirements, C4 architecture blueprints, ADRs, contracts, and standards. Skills to produce specs, and a CLI to navigate and maintain them. Take features from concept, to written specifications, to an implementation plan.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Release management with the release CLI: the cut-release skill previews and cuts a release with the release standards built in, provisioning the CLI version the plugin pins; the changelog skill authors a release's changelog for the CLI
